\]

\[
a(S-P)=1.

\[
S-P=\frac12\bigl((x-y)^2+(y-z)^2+(z-x)^2\bigr)\ge0,
\]
and the product is 1, we have $S-P>0$ and therefore $a>0$.

Thus $P=S-1/a$. Since $S=a^2-2P$,
\[
S=a^2-2\left(S-\frac1a\right),
\]
so
\[
S=\frac{a^2}{3}+\frac{2}{3a},\qquad a>0.
\]
Define $f(a)=a^2/3+2/(3a)$. Then
\[
f'(a)=\frac{2(a^3-1)}{3a^2}.
\]
Hence $f$ decreases on $(0,1)$ and increases on $(1,\infty)$, so its global minimum occurs at $a=1$. Therefore
\[
S\ge f(1)=1.
\]
Equality is attained at $(x,y,z)=(1,0,0)$, which satisfies the constraint and has $S=1$. Thus the minimum value is
\[
\boxed{1}.
